name: 李弘毅
objective: This course is one of the fundamental courses in the thermofluid sciences for graduate students. Based upon the concept of conservation, the equations of mass, momentum, and energy will be derived. This course will deal with solutions of these equations, both exact and approximate. The application of solutions includes irrotational flow, low Reynolds number flow, and high Reynolds number (boundary layer) flow, etc.

4. Fluid Statics

6. Introduction to fluids in Motion
7. The Integral Forms of the Fundamental Laws
8. The Integral Forms of the Fundamental Laws
9. Midterm Exam
10. The Differential Forms of the Fundamental Laws
11. The Differential Forms of the Fundamental Laws
12.Dimensional Analysis and Simitude
13. Dimensional Analysis and Simitude
14. Internal Flows
15. External Flows
16. Final Exam
